findings.title: Resus mode clock incorrectly paused in reasoning sections
findings.body: The `useEffect` in `ShiftView` sets `autoPaused` based purely on `REASONING_SECTIONS.has(focusedSection)`. However, `EncounterScreen` has a `resusActive` mode which is fundamentally time-critical. If a player is in a reasoning section (e.g., 'investigations') and toggles resus mode on, `autoPaused` remains `true`, shielding the player from real-time pressure during a resuscitation.
findings.recommendation: Lift the `resusActive` state so `ShiftView` can read it (or have `EncounterScreen` manage `autoPaused`), and ensure `autoPaused` is forced to `false` when resus mode is active.

findings.title: Workup parsimony counts are dead-ended in the debrief UI
findings.body: By hardcoding `workupPenalty = 0` in `scoreCase`, the debrief UI likely no longer displays the extra investigations count (assuming the UI previously conditioned the display on `penaltyPercent > 0`, which is standard for penalty line items). The pedagogical intent was to remove the score penalty but retain the feedback, but the diff does not add a dedicated line in `DebriefPhase` to surface `score.workup.extraIxOrdered`.
findings.recommendation:
Add a line in `DebriefPhase` to explicitly display `score.workup.extraIxOrdered` when it is > 0, e.g., `
  • Extra investigations ordered: {score.workup.extraIxOrdered} (no penalty)
    • `.

overall_take: The core logic for differential breadth and auto-pausing is solid (and correctly handles the string splitting for exam findings with colons), but the auto-pause mechanism conflicts with the time-critical nature of resus mode, and the workup parsimony feedback is inadvertently hidden from the UI.
